Get URLs for detailed PHIVOLCS earthquake information bulletins

Source: R/eq_get_bulletin_urls.R
eq_get_bulletin_link.Rd

Get URLs for detailed PHIVOLCS earthquake information bulletins

Usage

eq_get_bulletin_link(.url)

eq_get_bulletin_links(.url)

Arguments

.url

Base URL or monthly URL for PHIVOLCS earthquake bulletins. This is usually produced through a call to eq_build_url().

Value

A character vector of URLs for detailed PHIVOLCS earthquake information bulletins.

Examples

.url <- eq_build_url(.year = 2020, .month = "January")
eq_get_bulletin_links(.url)
